Chemical Synthetic Letters 2023;8(1):11-28

Graph Neural Networks for Molecular Property Prediction

Luis Fernandez, Aisha Khan
Department of Chemical Synthesis, University of Examples

Published 2023
DOI: 10.5555/synth.2023.020

Abstract
We evaluate graph neural networks for molecular property prediction.
The model is trained on synthetic molecular graphs and tested on held-out sets.
Performance exceeds baselines on regression and classification metrics.

We build on our sequel Graph Neural Networks for Molecular Property Prediction II: Multi-Task Extensions (doi:10.5555/synth.2025.021) for multi-task evaluation.
